title: The sharp logarithmic exponent of r(5,t)
summary: We determine the sharp logarithmic exponent of the off-diagonal Ramsey number $`r(5,t)`$: $`\displaystyle r(5,t)=\frac{t^4}{(\log t)^{3+o(1)}} \qquad (t\longrightarrow\infty).`$
family_title: Sharp logarithmic exponents for off-diagonal Ramsey numbers

review.reason: Determines the sharp logarithmic exponent of the off-diagonal Ramsey number r(5,t).
